bio.text: Jennifer Gong-Gershowitz is a Democratic member of the Illinois House of Representatives for the 17th District, based in Glenview.

According to her Illinois House Democrats biography, she is a human rights attorney with a B.A. from Indiana University, a J.D. from Loyola University Chicago School of Law and an LL.M. from Northwestern University's Pritzker School of Law.
The biography lists her as a former litigation attorney at Winston & Strawn and says she lives in Glenview with her husband and three sons.
